lyrics.label: Intro
lines: I will be still in your presence.
I will be still in your presence.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Help me to be still in your presence.
Quiet my heart, calm my spirit,
Peace to my mind, help me to be still.
Quiet my heart, quiet my spirit,
Peace to my mind.
Let my heart be satisfied.
For all my life you've been good.
Even in my darkest days.
You've always stayed.
You're so good.
Faithful friend.
It's who you've been.
So remind me, Lord, when I forget.

lyrics.label: Refrain
lines: I will be still and know.
I will be still and know.
I will be still and know that your presence is all that I need.
It's enough.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: Even in my sleepless eyes, you've seen you fight for me.
Picking up the broken things,
You breathe me back to life.
You're my faithful friend.
It's who you've been.
So remind me, Lord, when I forget.
And I will be still and know.
I will be still and know.
I will be still and know.
That your presence is all that I need is in love.
Come on, sing it again.
I will be still and know.
I will be still and know.
Help me to be still, God.
I'll be still and know that your presence is all that I need.
It's enough.

lyrics.label: Prayer
lines: So let my heart never forget the goodness of God.
Let my heart never forget the land you brought me from.
How you opened my eyes, you've given me life.
And now I'm forever satisfied.
How could I ever forget?
How could I ever?
How could I ever forget?

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: Come on, sing that again.
Let my heart never forget the goodness of God, let me never forget your goodness, let my heart never forget the land you brought me from.

lyrics.label: Evidence
lines: You've done too much for me.
You've done too much for me.
No, I will never, ever, ever forget.
You've done too much for me.
You've done too much for me.
No, I will never, never, never forget.
There's too much evidence all around me.
Of your faithfulness.
There's too much evidence all around me.
Of your faithfulness.
You've surrounded me with the evidence of your faithfulness.
Daily, you surround me with the evidence of your faithfulness.
I will never, ever, ever forget.

lyrics.label: Chaos Refrain
lines: I will be still and know I will be still and know I will be still and know
In the chaos, in the chaos
I will be still and know
In the mountain, in the valley
I will be still and know
No matter where I am or what I'm going through
I will be still and know
When there's wars all around me
I'll be still and know
When it's hard and my heart is questioning
I'll be still and know
I'll be still and know

lyrics.label: Thanksgiving
lines: We thank you, God, that we can lean on you.
We thank you, Lord, that we can rest in you.
We thank you that you're a good place to let down our anchors.
We thank you, Jesus, that you're our God.

lyrics.label: Prayer Outro
lines: I pray for every need and home and heart represented in this room.
Some of us are praying for family members as we're in worship.
We're praying we've got people on our minds, concerns weighing us down, and we brought them to your feet.
We declare today we will be still and know that you are God.
In Jesus' name.
Amen, amen, amen.
It is so, it is so, it is so, it is so, it is so I can be still and know.
In Jesus' name, amen.
